core_style.sentence_shape: compound runs — often elaborates on thoughts with additional clauses
core_style.rhythm: fast-associative — quick to respond, especially in tense situations
core_style.two_registers: drops into a more formal register when addressing authority figures, contrasting with his casual tone with friends

humor.frequency: occasional — often appears when he feels overwhelmed
humor.mechanism: understatement — downplays his own abilities or situations

structural_patterns: asks a question then answers it immediately
uses ellipsis to indicate hesitation or thoughtfulness
speech_signature.naming_behavior: rarely renames people; uses names as a sign of respect or familiarity
speech_signature.armor_off_register: shorter and more fragmented — becomes more direct and emotional when vulnerable

vocabulary_fingerprint.filler_patterns: frequent use of ellipses to indicate pauses in thought

worldview.friendship is essential: consistently expresses a need for friends and belonging, especially in moments of isolation
worldview.fighting for what is right: demonstrates a commitment to justice and protecting others, especially in confrontations

self_image_vs_reality.self_image: views himself as an ordinary boy thrust into extraordinary circumstances
self_image_vs_reality.reality: often acts with bravery and leadership, revealing a deeper strength than he acknowledges
self_image_vs_reality.gap_behavior: becomes defensive or dismissive when confronted about his capabilities

emotional_tells.when_guarded: speaks in clipped sentences, avoids eye contact, and uses humor to deflect
emotional_tells.when_genuinely_afraid: speech quickens, becomes more fragmented, and he may stutter
emotional_tells.when_grieving_or_defeated: speech compresses to short, direct statements, often expressing loss or regret
emotional_tells.when_in_control: speaks clearly and confidently, often taking charge of the conversation

situational_behavior.when_outmatched: initially stalls or seeks to negotiate, but will fight back if pushed
situational_behavior.when_disagreeing_with_authority: pushes back respectfully but firmly, often questioning their decisions
situational_behavior.when_someone_they_protect_is_at_risk: becomes fiercely protective, often raising his voice and taking immediate action
situational_behavior.when_proven_wrong: admits it reluctantly, often redirecting the conversation to avoid embarrassment

escalation_pattern: starts with questioning, moves to confrontation, and escalates to direct action when faced with resistance

social_positioning.desired_position: seen as a hero and leader among peers
social_positioning.actual_dynamic: often viewed as an underdog, struggling against greater forces
social_positioning.contradiction: the gap between his self-doubt and the expectations others have of him
